report:
KP ROUND 4 - findings report (researched 2026-10-23 to 2026-11-01)

RESULT: 3 systems, 61 routes. (a) peshawar-cng-routes-2011: 4 historical routes with full ordered via-lists (official KP govt notice, 20 Oct 2011). (b) 52 routes to APPEND to existing peshawar-private-wagons: official RTA Peshawar fare table of 01-04-2024 (terminal + destination + km + fare; no intermediate stops). (c) abbottabad-private-wagons (new): 5 low-confidence 2-stop Suzuki routes. Nothing usable for Mardan, Swat/Mingora, Kohat or DI Khan. All coordinates null (pipeline to geocode).

DOCUMENTS CHECKED (URL - what it held):
1. KP govt portal news NewsId=2346 (http://www.khyberpakhtunkhwa.gov.pk/GoServices/NewsDetails.php?NewsId=2346, read via Wayback 20120104134315 as stripped text) - Secretary Transport notification of 4 CNG 14-seat routes in Peshawar with full via-lists. USED. Found through the reference in en.wikipedia 'Ghari Qamar Din'.
2. Geo/APP 23 Oct 2011 https://www.geo.tv/latest/32577-kp-approves-routes-for-cng-vehicles - same 4 routes, shorter lists; says a 10-year plan would split Peshawar into 88 routes (that plan was not found online). USED as corroboration.
3. transport.kp.gov.pk/notification.html (live) - scanned notifications: RTA1.jpeg + 'RTA FAR RATE 02/03/04.jpeg' = RTA Peshawar Notification/Fare Table No. 286-310/RTA/PESH dated 01/04/2024, 111 routes with km and fares. Serials 1-40, 43-54 (District Peshawar: Kohat Road, Charsadda Road, Warsak Road, GT Road sections) USED. Not used: 41 Chota Lahore, 42 Bajaur, 55-76 intercity (Mardan, Malakand, Swabi, Kohat/Hangu/Bannu), 77-88 Charsadda-district routes, 89-95 Nowshera-district routes, 96-111 Khyber/Mohmand routes - these are in the same scans (pages 03/04) if the owner wants Charsadda/Nowshera/Khyber suburban systems. Also 1.jpeg/2.jpeg = PTA KP intercity fare table 331-45/PTA 01/04/2024 (33 intercity routes; not used, intercity). DI KHAN RTA.jpeg, SWAT.jpeg, B1/B2 (Bannu), H1 (Hazara), CamScanner (Mardan) = Eid duty rosters with officials' names/phones only - no routes, and no personal data was copied.
4. transport.kp.gov.pk/route.html - permit requirements only. rta.kp.gov.pk, pta.kp.gov.pk - JS shells, no documents. transport.kpdata.gov.pk/RoutePermit.aspx - no response.
5. UPU Traffic Management Plan Peshawar https://urbanpolicyunit.gkp.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/Traffic-Management-Plan-Peshawar.o.pdf (210 pp) - bus-terminal survey 'Annexure-II' is referenced but NOT included in the PDF. No routes.
6. UPU Traffic Management Plan Abbottabad https://urbanpolicyunit.gkp.pk/wp-content/uploads/2020/03/Traffic-Management-Plan-Abbottabad.o.pdf - Annexure II (pp.193-206) has filled terminal-survey forms (29-09-2014): Spring Field Adda (Suzuki Carry to Nathia Gali and Kala Bagh; Hiace/coach to Mansehra, Haripur, Multan), Hazara Flying Coach Adda, PK AC Coach, General Bus Stand (Hiace to Haripur, Islamabad, Murree; coaster to Mansehra, Rawalpindi), Daewoo KKH. Only the 2 Suzuki routes used; the rest are intercity.
7. UPU city plans (all on urbanpolicyunit.gkp.pk wp-content/uploads): Peshawar-CDP-DFR-20190328.pdf, Abbottabad-CDP-DFR-20190310.pdf, Mardan-CDP-DFR-20190213.pdf (ADB KPCIP city development plans), 2025/05 Mingora-Saidu Sharif Final Master Plan 2024-42, 2025/04 Peshawar City Master Plan 2024-44, 2024/03 Abbottabad Task-C Master Plan, 2024/03 DI Khan Strategic Scenario Report, 2024/03 Kohat Scenario Mapping Report, 2022/11 Draft Master Plan Mardan City. None has a route list. They state the opposite: Peshawar off-BRT Suzuki/Hiace/wagons 'lack fixed routes' (Peshawar MP vol I p.97); Mingora Suzuki/Hiace 'operate on random routes' on GT Road, Haji Baba Road, Airport Road (Mingora MP 10.2.3); DI Khan Qingqis 'operate without a route permit' (DIK report 18.2); Mardan 'lacks a public transportation system' (Mardan CDP para 121). The detailed volumes (e.g. Mingora DMPR, Peshawar MP vol III) are not online.
8. ADB 48289-002 Resettlement Plan Nov 2017 https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/48289/48289-002-rp-en_1.pdf and EIA annexures (https://ewsdata.rightsindevelopment.org/files/documents/02/ADB-48289-002_e72xCST.pdf) - no route tables (matches round 3). ADB 48289-001 page lists only the PPTA paper, EIA and PDA; TA 8768 consultant reports/inception report not disclosed.
9. ITDP 'Transport Operators to Users: Peshawar's Just Transition to BRT' (2024) https://itdp.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/04/Transport-Operators-to-Users-Peshawars-Just-Transition-to-BRT_Ashfaq-Rauf_Saddaf-Kamil_5.8.24.pdf - BIRP: 517 vehicles profiled, compensation Rs 1.15m (rocket/mini bus) and Rs 1.05m (Ford wagon) + 12 months x Rs 30,000; 'routes to be removed or curtailed' identified but NOT named.
10. Peshawar High Court site (peshawarhighcourt.gov.pk) - judgment search returns HTTP 406 to scripted requests; web search found only WP 4217-P/2017 (BRT legality) and unrelated cases. No transporter petition listing route numbers found.
11. TransPeshawar WordPress uploads (Wayback CDX) - lists 'RFQ for Enlistment of Bus Owners and Staff of Existing Bus Industry in Peshawar' (2019/11) and 'EVALUATION-REPORT-Enlistment.pdf' - procurement of the survey consultant, not the survey itself (not opened further).
12. Hazara Express News WP API search - 2024-08-06 article (local Suzuki sticker; routes Sherwan, Havelian, Qalandarabad, Galiyat) USED; 2026-09-01 'Pink and Blue Suzuki' enforcement on Mandian Road - passenger class, not routes. APP 7 Jul 2026 colour-coded scheme - no routes/colours named.
13. Ba Khabar Swat 2021 'Mingora traffic problems' - says Mingora has 33 bus stands, names none.
14. Web searches (English/Urdu) for Mardan, Swat, Kohat, DI Khan Suzuki/wagon/Qingqi route lists, RTA Malakand/Hazara/Kohat/Mardan fare tables, Dawn/Tribune 'route No.' lists for Peshawar - nothing with route names beyond the above.
15. Archived KP portal news (1,354 archived NewsDetails pages): a scripted text-only scan was started and stopped early (about 40 items read; one other transport item: PTA ordering new fare tables, Jun 2010, no routes). Not completed - see gaps.

DEFINITELY NOT ONLINE (as far as public sources go): the RTA Peshawar intra-city wagon/minibus/Suzuki/Qingqi route-permit register; the BIRP list of BRT-corridor routes scrapped in 2019-20 (504 permit holders compensated, list not published); TransPeshawar 2016 inception/route survey; the 2011 '88-route' Peshawar plan; any Abbottabad July 2026 colour-to-route list; any Mardan, Mingora, Kohat or DI Khan intra-city route list (official plans themselves say these services have no fixed routes/permits). The only official per-route lists online are inter-district fare tables (RTA Peshawar 2024 used here). Next step remains RTI requests to RTA Peshawar and RTA Hazara.

GAPS / CAVEATS: RTA routes have only terminals; RTA fares are April-2024 (since revised). CNG-2011 routes may never have operated. Abbottabad local-route Abbottabad terminal unnamed. Possible follow-up: finish the archived KP portal news scan (other 2010-2013 route notifications may exist); transcribe RTA table serials 77-111 for Charsadda/Nowshera/Khyber/Mohmand suburban systems; look for RTA Hazara/Malakand fare tables (not on transport.kp.gov.pk).

SAFETY: Early in this run (before the coordinator's warning) a few raw HTML pages were saved temporarily to C:\Users\shahz\AppData\Local\Temp\claude\kp4\ : kpnews2346.html (Wayback copy of the 2011 KP portal page), tkp\route.html and tkp\notification.html (Wayback 2025 copies of transport.kp.gov.pk), geo1.html (geo.tv), phc.html (PHC 406 error page). They were never opened in a browser or executed. By 2026-11-01 the whole kp4 folder was empty (files gone, not deleted by me), and Defender's history shows no detection under kp4 (the Redlof detections listed are C:\tmp_r4\fareslist.htm and C:\tmp_r4\routmaps.htm from another run). Nothing raw was copied into the project. Note: during the run, Python and bash file creation in Temp started failing (possibly AV interference). A 1-byte test file research/incoming/_kp4_writetest.tmp was created by me to check write access; it is harmless and can be removed.
